# `adt check`

Run syntax check (checkruns) on ABAP objects

```bash
adt check [options] [objects...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument       | Description             | Default |
| -------------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `[objects...]` | Object name(s) to check |         |

**Options**

| Option                        | Description                                                                                                  | Default    |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| `-p, --package <package>`     | Check all objects in a package                                                                               |            |
| `-t, --transport <transport>` | Check all objects in a transport request                                                                     |            |
| `--type <type>`               | Object type hint for resolving URIs (e.g., CLAS, DOMA)                                                       |            |
| `--source-version <version>`  | Source version to check One of: active, inactive, workingArea, new, partlyActive, activeWithInactiveVersion. | `inactive` |
| `--json`                      | Output results as JSON                                                                                       |            |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
